title: Untested call sites: very common names make every call site in a function of that name count as reached.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The Untested call sites check goes by function names (`untestedcallsites.go:76-81`). It records `fun.Sel.Name` for every selector call, whatever the receiver. A test that calls `t.Run(...)` therefore marks the name `Run` as reached. A product function named `Run` then never counts as an unreached call site, so a new function that only `Run` calls is never flagged. Test-harness methods such as `h.start()` cause the same collision. S564's own fixture passes only because its test file never calls `t.Run`.

Owner decision (adj 583, `untestedcallsites.common-names`): do both fixes. Selector calls on a `*testing.T` receiver stop counting as calls, and the section gains a collisions line for names the check cannot tell apart.

The slice also covers a second finding from the same S564 review run. The reviewer round reads the branch diff twice, once for Base overlays (`baseoverlay.go:33`) and once for Untested call sites (`untestedcallsites.go:235`). `engine_test.go:957` records the doubled count (`2*reviewers`). `round.go` computes `branchChange` once per reviewer round and passes the result to both sections.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-25: adj 583 (skip *testing.T selector calls, plus a collisions line) and adj 587 (the collisions line lists reached call-site names declared by more than one function in the worktree).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestUntestedCallSitesIgnoresTestingTReceiver (`untestedcallsites_test.go`): `x.go` declares `Helper`. `y.go` has `func Run() int { return Helper() }`. `x_test.go` has `TestHelper(t *testing.T)` that calls `Helper()` and `t.Run("a", func(t *testing.T) { t.Run("b", nil) })`. `ucsFind` returns one finding, `Helper` with site `y.go` in `Run`. Today `Run` counts as reached and nothing is returned.
- TestUntestedCallSitesCountsOtherSelectorCalls (guard, passes before and after): same files, but the test calls `h.Run()` with `h` an untyped identifier, and a second test uses `func TestB(t T) { t.Run() }`, where `T` is not `testing.T`. There are no findings, because those selector calls still count.
- TestUntestedCallSitesReportsCollisions: `x.go` declares a new `Helper`. `y.go` has `func Run() int { return Helper() }`. `z.go` has `func (s S) Run() {}`. `x_test.go` calls `Helper()` and `h.Run()`. The call returns no findings and one collision: name `Run`, declared in `y.go` as `Run` and in `z.go` as `S.Run`, sorted by file then key.
- TestUntestedCallSitesCollisionNeedsAHiddenFinding, with two subtests:
  - "declared once": the `TestUntestedCallSitesReachedByTest` tree gives no collision.
  - "site not reached": `Run` is declared in both `y.go` and `z.go`, no test calls `Run`, and `Helper` is flagged. There is no collision.
- TestUntestedCallSitesCollisionsLine: a reviewer-harness run with `internal/x/x.go`, `y.go`, `z.go` and `x_test.go` as in the collisions test. The brief holds the Untested call sites section with no `- ` entry lines and no "Check incomplete". The body contains "cannot tell apart" and `` `Run` ``, so the section appears even when no function is flagged.
- TestBaseOverlayAndUntestedCallSitesShareOneBranchRead (`baseoverlay_test.go`): a reviewer round on `ucsReviewerFiles` renders both the Base overlays and the Untested call sites sections. `h.calls` shows exactly one `symbolic-ref` on the main checkout, one `merge-base main HEAD`, one `diff --name-only` and one `ls-files --others` for each reviewer round.
- TestAProblemWithNoItemOrAStaleRenderStaysRed (`engine_test.go:923`, existing): the read count expectation changes from `2*reviewers` to `reviewers`, and the comment at lines 948-950 changes to match. It fails until `round.go` shares the result.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/untestedcallsites.go`, change `ucsParse`. Before recording calls, gather the identifier names bound to a `*testing.T` parameter. Look at the `FuncDecl` parameters and at every `*ast.FuncLit` parameter list in the body. A helper `ucsIsTestingT(expr)` matches `*testing.T` as `StarExpr{SelectorExpr{Ident "testing", "T"}}`. In the call walk, skip an `*ast.SelectorExpr` whose `X` is an `*ast.Ident` in that set. Shadowing is ignored, since the check goes by names. Other selector and ident calls are recorded as before.
2. Add `type untestedCollision struct { Name string; Decls []untestedSite }`, with `File` and `Func` as the key. Change `untestedCallSites` to return `([]untestedFinding, []untestedCollision, []string)`. Count the declarations of each name across `funcs`, tests included. Add a collision when a new directly tested function's product call site sits in a function whose name is reached and is declared more than once. This is the case that sets `callSiteReached`. Record each such name once, with all its declarations sorted by file then key, and sort the collisions by name.
3. In `untestedCallSitesSection`, take a `branchChangeResult` argument (step 5) instead of calling `e.branchChange`. Render the collisions as one paragraph beginning "Names the check cannot tell apart" that lists each name and its declarations as `` `file` in `key` ``. It carries no `- ` list prefix. The "Tests call these new functions directly..." paragraph stays tied to findings. Return nil only when there are no findings, collisions, unread or unparsed files.
4. In `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go`, change `baseOverlaySection` to take the same `branchChangeResult` and drop its own `e.branchChange` call. Its empty-merge-base check and its incomplete-check text stay.
5. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, add `type branchChangeResult struct { MergeBase string; Paths []string; Err error }` next to `branchChange`. `branchChange` and `branchPaths` keep their signatures.
6. In `internal/engine/round.go`, in the `r.role == RoleReviewer` block, call `e.branchChange(ctx, rec)` once. Build a `branchChangeResult` and pass it to `baseOverlaySection` and `untestedCallSitesSection`. `decisionPathsSection` stays as it is.
7. Update the tests in the Failing tests list. Keep the two-value `ucsFind` for the existing cases, and add `ucsFindAll` for the three-value form.
8. In `docs/design.md`, update the Untested call sites bullet (lines 2059-2080): selector calls on a `*testing.T` parameter do not count as calls; the section adds a collisions line for reached names declared more than once; Base overlays and Untested call sites share one branch diff read per reviewer round. Rewrite the "goes by function names" sentence to match.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Acceptance: a *testing.T selector call no longer marks a name reached, a collisions line appears for names declared more than once, and a reviewer round makes one branch diff read shared by both sections.
- `go test -run TestUntestedCallSitesIgnoresTestingTReceiver ./internal/engine` passes (fails before the change).
- `go test -run TestUntestedCallSitesCountsOtherSelectorCalls ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestUntestedCallSitesReportsCollisions ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestUntestedCallSitesCollisionNeedsAHiddenFinding ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestUntestedCallSitesCollisionsLine ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayAndUntestedCallSitesShareOneBranchRead ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestAProblemWithNoItemOrAStaleRenderStaysRed ./internal/engine` passes with the reviewers read count.
- `go test ./...` passes.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing and exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
